description: Frontend foundation + auth UI + Main Dashboard. Replace the single App.tsx dashboard with a real multi-page app: routing, an API client with Bearer token + 401 handling, an AuthContext with login/register/logout + token persistence, role-based route guards, an AppLayout with role-aware sidebar nav, a hand-rolled UI component library (Radix-free, matching the navy/white + blue/green theme) instead of shadcn to avoid alias/Radix config churn and keep `npm run build` stable, the Login + Registration pages, and the Main Dashboard page whose KPIs and charts all come from the real /api/dashboard endpoint. No hardcoded dashboard numbers.
steps: Create e:/SIH26262/frontend/src/api/client.ts: a fetch wrapper using import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE (default http://localhost:8000/api) that attaches Bearer token from localStorage, JSON handling, throws on !ok with the server message, and on 401 clears the token + redirects to /login. Export typed helpers apiGet/apiPost/apiPut/apiPatch/apiDelete and a apiDownload for CSV.

Create e:/SIH26262/frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx: React context providing user, login(email,password), register(payload), logout, loading; persists token in localStorage; fetches /api/auth/me on mount if a token exists; exposes useAuth().

Create e:/SIH26262/frontend/src/components/ui/ hand-rolled components matching navy/white + blue/green (use the existing tailwind brand tokens and shadow-card): Button, Card, CardHeader/Title/Content, Input, Textarea, Select, Badge, Spinner, EmptyState, ErrorState, Modal (Dialog), ConfirmDialog, Toast/Toaster (context + container), Tabs, Table primitives, PageHeader, StatCard (KPI card), ChartCard. Keep them accessible (labels, aria). No new npm deps.

Create e:/SIH26262/frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx: sticky header (brand 'NEXORA AICTE', current role badge, notifications bell linking to /notifications, user menu with logout) + a responsive sidebar with role-aware nav items (only links the role can access) + a mobile-friendly collapse. Reuse lucide-react icons.

Create e:/SIH26262/frontend/src/routes.tsx: route definitions for all 15 pages; a ProtectedRoute wrapper that redirects to /login when unauthenticated; a RoleRoute that redirects to the user's dashboard when the role is not allowed; role->default-dashboard mapping.
Rewrite e:/SIH26262/frontend/src/App.tsx to render <Routes> from routes.tsx inside AuthProvider (keep main.tsx BrowserRouter). Remove the old hardcoded dashboard JSX entirely.

Create e:/SIH26262/frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx and Register.tsx (page 1): forms calling the auth context; on success redirect to the role dashboard; show loading + error states; demo-login quick buttons that fill the 5 demo role credentials (clearly labeled fictional demo).

Create e:/SIH26262/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx (page 2): fetch /api/dashboard (scoped by role from the backend); render the 8 KPI StatCards and 6 charts (status distribution Bar, region pendency Pie, applications by stage Bar, monthly trend Bar, compliance completion progress bars, upcoming deadlines list/chart) using recharts; add filters (region/type/status/stage/date range) that re-query; loading skeletons, empty states, error state. All numbers come from the API.

Verify `cd frontend && npm run build` passes (tsc -b && vite build, 0 TS errors) and `npm run dev` serves; login as each of the 5 roles lands on /dashboard with live KPIs/charts. Commit: `git add -A && git commit -m 'FEAT-009: frontend foundation, auth UI, main dashboard'` with build output + login results.
acceptance_criteria: `cd frontend && npm run build` succeeds with 0 TypeScript errors.
Login + register call the real backend; on success the user lands on the role dashboard; 401 logs out and redirects to /login.
The sidebar shows only the nav items the current role may access.
The Main Dashboard KPIs and charts render from /api/dashboard; there are no hardcoded dashboard numbers in the page (all values come from the API response).
Loading, empty, and error states are present on the dashboard.
No new npm dependencies were added (only existing react/react-router/recharts/lucide).
verification: cd e:/SIH26262/frontend && npm run build  (exits 0, no TS errors)

Start backend (uvicorn) and frontend (npm run dev); open http://localhost:5173/login; use each demo role's quick-login; confirm each lands on /dashboard with KPI numbers that change per role (regional officer sees only their region's totals).
Confirm the dashboard filters re-query the API and update the charts.
Open browser devtools network: dashboard data comes from GET /api/dashboard, not a hardcoded constant.
